answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities across cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Staking tiers scale by cost C(n)=k*2^n per identity, forcing exponential capital exhaustion onto attacking swarms. Like mining through dense shale, extracting unearned consensus demands massive resource burn, forging a ferrous economic barrier before malicious nodes can reach the summit of governance influence.
